scope: Original concept and mechanic proposals; not released AoA items or licensed reference-pack assets

records.name: Soul Lantern
records.theme_fit: Soul Storm and other eligible Spirit consumers
records.proposed_bonus: Small bounded Spirit-cost efficiency benefit; preserve a nonzero cost floor and authoritative charging.
records.proposed_unlock: Spirit-weapon mastery challenge; exact version-specific objective pending

records.name: Storm Seal
records.proposed_bonus: Modest focus-settle improvement; no unlisted damage or automatic targeting.
records.proposed_unlock: Accuracy or focus challenge; exact thresholds pending

records.name: Crimson Capacitor
records.proposed_bonus: Small post-burst recovery benefit; do not duplicate either impact branch or alter pellet count implicitly.
records.proposed_unlock: Discharge mastery milestone; actual unlock rules pending

records.name: Boulder Knot
records.proposed_bonus: Grounded handling stability with a declared mobility tradeoff; no covert unconditional damage increase.
records.proposed_unlock: Grounded challenge route; exact objective pending

records.name: Mycelium Medallion
records.proposed_bonus: Limited collection convenience for eligible owned ammunition pickups; respect ownership, inventory capacity and server rules.
records.proposed_unlock: Exploration/collection achievement route; exact conditions pending

records.name: Clockwork Core
records.proposed_bonus: Small supported equip/recovery benefit; optional reload benefit only for modes that actually implement magazines.
records.proposed_unlock: Mechanical-weapon mastery route; exact encounter pending

shared_rules: Stable ownership identifiers are distinct from player-renamable display names
No bonus applied twice after duplicated reward/equipment events
Define slots, duplicate stacking and minimum resource costs before integration
Secondary motion and low-motion mode must leave the same gameplay bonus
No canonical boss source is invented from visual style
